Final Answer: 1.88

To calculate the annual return, we use the formula:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{\text{Ending Price} - \text{Beginning Price}}{\text{Beginning Price}}
$$

Plugging in the values:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{167.38 - 140.88}{140.88} = \frac{26.50}{140.88} \approx 0.188 \text{ or } 18.8\%
$$

Next, the Sharpe Ratio is calculated as:

$$
\text{Sharpe Ratio} = \frac{\text{Annual Return} - \text{Risk-Free Rate}}{\text{Standard Deviation}}
$$

Using the given risk-free rate of 1.42% (0.0142) and standard deviation of 1
